question: What will be the ending value of the UST 10Y Yield for these biweekly periods of Q4 2026? (Nov 23 - Dec 4)

calls.reasoning: DGS10 is ~5.13-5.15 on Nov 16 (FRED last print 5.10 on Nov 12; one-month high on Nov 13 after a hot October CPI and Waller's hawkish remarks). Fed funds futures price a Dec 9 hike as near-certain, so much of the hawkish news is already in the price. A random walk centered on the current level with an elevated-regime 14-trading-day SD of ~24bp, slightly fat-tailed; the Nov jobs report likely lands on the Dec 4 resolution day. Market check: no matching market; Kalshi's year-end contract (Dec 31, 98% above 4.74) is a near-miss on date and threshold, used only for consistency. The range bounds are >3.5 SD away, so no escape mass.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on spot (~5.13-5.15), on a random-walk anchor, and on a ~24bp horizon SD. Small factual dispute: spot 5.13 (CNBC intraday Nov 16) vs 5.15 (TradingEconomics). These can't be told apart without web access; both are vendor quotes that may differ from the H.15 CMT by 1-3bp, so I centered at 5.13-5.14. The jobs report falling on Dec 4 is unverified but the usual first-Friday schedule supports it, so I kept a slight tail widening. Run 3's slightly lower median (mean reversion after the spike) is a judgment call that no evidence settles; I used near-spot. Dispersion carried forward from the runs, which I agree with. No escape mass: the bounds are ~3.6+ SD away.
